name: OWASP Top 10 Web Application Security Risks
disclaimer: Independent academic static-analysis mapping to OWASP Top 10:2025. No OWASP endorsement or certification is claimed.

controls.title: Broken Access Control
controls.description: Authorization gaps can allow users to access actions or data beyond their permissions.
controls.verification_guidance: Test object, property, and function authorization across user roles and request paths.

controls.title: Security Misconfiguration
controls.description: Unsafe defaults or deployment and application configuration errors can expose the application.
controls.verification_guidance: Review debug settings, CORS, TLS, default credentials, and deployment exposure.

controls.title: Software Supply Chain Failures
controls.description: Compromised or vulnerable software dependencies and build components can undermine the application.
controls.verification_guidance: Review dependency inventories, vulnerability status, provenance, and build integrity.

controls.title: Cryptographic Failures
controls.description: Weak cryptographic practices or exposed secrets can compromise confidentiality and integrity.
controls.verification_guidance: Inspect secret storage, cryptographic configuration, and transport security.

controls.title: Injection
controls.description: Untrusted data interpreted as commands, queries, or markup can cause unintended execution.
controls.verification_guidance: Trace untrusted data to SQL, shell, template, and browser rendering sinks.

controls.title: Insecure Design
controls.description: Missing or ineffective security design controls can expose fundamental application risks.
controls.verification_guidance: Review trust boundaries, threat models, abuse cases, and security requirements.

controls.title: Authentication Failures
controls.description: Authentication and session weaknesses can enable impersonation or account compromise.
controls.verification_guidance: Test identity verification, credential protection, session handling, and recovery flows.

controls.title: Software or Data Integrity Failures
controls.description: Unverified code, data, or updates can be tampered with and cause unsafe behavior.
controls.verification_guidance: Verify source and integrity of dependencies, serialized data, models, and update artifacts.

controls.title: Security Logging and Alerting Failures
controls.description: Insufficient security event logging or alerting can delay detection and response.
controls.verification_guidance: Verify relevant event coverage, protected logs, alerting, and sensitive-data redaction.

controls.title: Mishandling of Exceptional Conditions
controls.description: Unexpected conditions handled unsafely can expose data or leave the application in an insecure state.
controls.verification_guidance: Review exception handling, safe failure behavior, and exposure of internal errors.
